resources.title: Web cache deception
resources.description: This learning path covers web cache deception vulnerabilities. Youll learn how to identify discrepancies between how the origin server and cache handle requests and how to leverage the discrepancies to create path confusion.

resources.title: WebSockets vulnerabilities
resources.description: This learning path covers the identification and exploitation of security vulnerabilities specific to WebSockets in web applications.

resources.title: Authentication vulnerabilities
resources.description: This learning path explores authentication vulnerabilities, which have a critical impact on security. Youll learn about common mechanisms and vulnerabilities, and strategies for robust authentication.

resources.title: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) attacks
resources.description: This learning path teaches you about server-side request forgery (SSRF). Youll learn about its impact, common techniques used in attacks, and how to defend against them.

resources.title: Prototype pollution
resources.description: This learning path introduces you to prototype pollution vulnerabilities in JavaScript. Youll learn what prototype pollution is, how it can be exploited, and how to prevent it in your applications.

resources.title: Clickjacking (UI redressing)
resources.description: This learning path deals with clickjacking attacks. Youll learn the fundamentals of clickjacking, how to construct basic attacks, and implement server-side and client-side defense strategies.

resources.title: GraphQL API vulnerabilities
resources.description: This learning path explores common vulnerabilities associated with GraphQL APIs due to implementation and design flaws. Youll learn how to find GraphQL endpoints, bypass some common defenses, and exploit a range of GraphQL API vulnerabilities.

resources.title: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS)
resources.description: This learning path provides an in-depth understanding of CORS, including common examples of CORS-based attacks and how to protect against these attacks.

resources.title: Path traversal
resources.description: This learning path covers path traversal vulnerabilities. Youll learn how to carry out path traversal attacks and circumvent common obstacles. Youll also learn how to prevent path traversal attacks.

resources.title: NoSQL injection
resources.description: This learning path covers the detection, exploitation, and prevention of NoSQL injection vulnerabilities. Youll explore the differences between NoSQL and SQL injection, learn how to perform NoSQL syntax injection, and how to use NoSQL operators to manipulate queries.

resources.title: Race conditions
resources.description: This learning path covers race conditions, a common vulnerability in web applications where concurrent processes lead to unintended behavior. Youll learn how to identify, exploit, and prevent race conditions, leveraging tools like Burp Suites Repeater and the Turbo Intruder extension.

resources.title: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
resources.description: This learning path covers CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery). Youll learn about some common CSRF vulnerabilities, and how to prevent them.

resources.title: File upload vulnerabilities
resources.description: In this learning path, youll explore how simple file upload functions can become a vector for severe attacks. Youll learn how to bypass common defense mechanisms to upload a web shell, enabling full control over a vulnerable web server.

resources.title: Web LLM attacks
resources.description: This learning path teaches you how to perform attacks using Large Language Models (LLMs). Youll learn how to construct attacks that take advantage of an LLMs access to data, API, and user information that you would not be able to access directly.

resources.title: API testing
resources.description: This learning path teaches you how to test APIs that arent fully used by the website front-end. Youll learn key API recon skills to help you discover more attack surface. In addition, youll learn how to identify server-side parameter pollution vulnerabilities that may impact internal APIs.

resources.title: Server-side vulnerabilities
resources.description: This learning path introduces you to a range of common server-side vulnerabilities. This is perfect if youre new to web security and want to get an overview of the kinds of vulnerabilities that exist, as well as how an attacker might identify and exploit them in real-world systems.

resources.title: SQL injection
resources.description: This learning path introduces SQL injection (SQLi), a critical web vulnerability. Youll learn how to detect and exploit SQLi to uncover hidden data and manipulate application behavior, as well as essential techniques to secure applications against SQLi attacks.
